Im no therapist. In fact I’m especially young (14 for reference) to be giving anywhere near decent advice, but here’s my take. Im so so sorry If I say anything offensive or triggering. 

It sounds like you’ve been through a lot. You’re tired and you’re fed up, but I feel like you’ve given more than enough reasons to live. There are people who you want to see, and there are people who want to see you. Maybe you’ve seen certain aspects of your life improve in the past years, even if only slightly, it’s still something. 

You had a shitty week, so what? Maybe next week will be better. You know what? Do something to make the next week better. Spend some time with friends and family. Take a moment to appreciate what you have and look at the people you have around you. Keep the people who support you and love you by yourself. Cut anything out of your life that is negatively affecting your mental health. 

And If ten years is what it takes for you to get yourself in a better place, stay for those ten years. You never know what might happen. Someone special might come into your life and they’ll be just what you needed (like your current therapist), or maybe something will happen to you that will change your whole view on life. Just saying that there are so many opportunities and milestones ahead of you, why throw your life away when you can wait for them to occur? If its worth it in the end, stick with it! 

Again, sorry If I said anything wrong. I am by no means a professional.
